newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer to spin off ELMA unit, list stock.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer to spin off ELMA unit, list stock.

text.p: Sulzer AG said it would spin off its ELMA Electronic AG unit and list its shares on the Swiss bourse at the start of December.

It gave no issue price for ELMA, which makes components and systems for the telecommunications and electronic industries. It employes 340 peoples and expects 1996 group sales of around 70 million Swiss francs, Sulzer said in a statement.
"Making this successful unit independent marks another step in implementing Sulzer's strategy of concentrating on clearly defined business areas," it said.
It quoted Peter Favre, managing director of the ELMA group, as saying the move would help it boost its market position in western Europe and North America.
Sulzer said it would give more details about the share issue at a news conference on November 25.
